question: Santoor is associated with whom among the following?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pandit Shivkumar Sharma.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pandit Shivkumar Sharma is associated with Santoor.**
 
• **He is a renowned Indian classical musician who is known for his mastery in playing the santoor, a stringed musical instrument.**
 
• He is one of the pioneers of Indian classical music fusion and has collaborated with many renowned musicians from India and abroad.
 
• He has been honored with several awards and accolades, including the** Padma Shri, Padma Bhushan, and Padma Vibhushan.**
 
• Apart from his musical career, he has also composed music for** several Bollywood movies.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Pandit Jasraj was a renowned Indian classical vocalist who belonged to the Mewati gharana.**

 
 
• He was known for his soulful renditions of classical ragas and was honored with several awards, including the Padma Vibhushan and the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award.
 
 
 
• **Pandit Bhimsen Joshi was a legendary Indian classical vocalist who belonged to the Kirana gharana.**
 
 
• He was known for his powerful voice and his ability to evoke emotions through his music.
 
• He was honored with several awards, including the Bharat Ratna, Padma Vibhushan, and Padma Bhushan.
 
 
 
• **Hari Prasad Chaurasia is a renowned Indian classical flautist who is known for his mastery in playing the bansuri, a bamboo flute.**
 
 
• He has collaborated with many renowned musicians and has been honored with several awards, including the Padma Shri, Padma Bhushan, and Padma Vibhushan.
